ModMetaData.name: Dawn of a New Day
ModMetaData.author: AlenDio
ModMetaData.description: Adds a customizable header overlay that displays at the start of the day. Settings Go to: Options > Mod options > "Dawn of a New Day" Mod Compatibility - Modern Notifications: Added formats and texts for Reminders and Occasions. Latest Patch # v1.6.0 - Added Modern Notifications mod compatibility. - Added Modern Notifications formats and texts for Reminders and Occasions. - Updated Mod Options ui look. # v1.6.1 - Updated Chinese translation (by hotaru-hoshizora). Can be safely added or removed from existing saves at any time.
